description: Returns the state business records filed under the name of each company or fund a loan's prospectus names as guarantor or sponsor (entity number, status, formation, registered agent, addresses, officers or managers where the state publishes them, each with its source) and the people tied to it, with whether a business email, mobile number or LinkedIn is on file. A record matches on the same name, word for word: it does not prove it is the company the filing means. Use reveal_contact for one person's contact details. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns a plan notice.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans
